blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **мочь → Можете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: You don't need to wrap it.
I don't want to be a burden.
I go to the southwest of the village.

exercises.why: **думать → думает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: He thinks of nothing but making money.

exercises.q: Ты на всё ___ (смотреть) через призму денег.
exercises.why: **смотреть → смотришь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
exercises.prompt: You see everything in terms of money.

exercises.why: **жить → живём** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**делать → делает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
